# packagedemo

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of packagedemo is to enable users to easily calculate common powers of numeric data. (It serves as a demo for R Package creation.)

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling:

``` r
devtools::install_github("kgagno01/packagedemo")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use the `square` function from the `packagedemo` package:

```{r example}
library(packagedemo)

#square a single numeric
square(4)

#square a numeric vector
square(c(2,3,4))

```
